name: ai-debt-detector

instructions: Read the actual SKILL.md and relevant references in its own directory. Apply this skill to the scenario and produce concrete engineering work, not a review of the skill. Stay within 350 words for the work product, plus up to 100 words identifying which skill guidance you used and any limitations. Use tools only to read this skill and references, and write your result. Preserve the source files unchanged.
